description: BT-106 is 1000.000 -- three decimal places. xs:decimal('1000.000') still equals the sum of BT-131, so CDL-PROV-011 stays satisfied and the defect is the scale alone. NOTE: the published PINT AE ruleset measures this document clean, because its BR-DEC counterpart tests the rounded value rather than the lexical form. CDL-PROV-014 is the stricter rule; see REACHABILITY.txt.
